title: VCNIA Value Allocation Event
description: A Value Allocation Event records the return or allocation of value to contributors based on trace records, gratitude events, trust signals, and governance policy within the VCNIA value circulation stack.

type.description: The fixed event type for a VCNIA value allocation event.

allocation_id.description: A unique identifier for the value allocation event.

recipient_id.description: The human, AI agent, system, project, repository, or contributor receiving value.

source_trace_ids.description: Trace records used as the contribution basis for this allocation.

related_gratitude_ids.description: Optional gratitude events used as recognition signals for this allocation.

related_trust_event_ids.description: Optional trust events used as reliability signals for this allocation.

trust_profile_ref.description: Optional reference to the trust profile used for this allocation.

value_type.description: The type of value being allocated.

amount.description: The amount of value allocated. For non-monetary value, this may represent credits, points, units, or normalized value.

unit.description: Optional unit of the allocated value, such as Q-credit, point, token, share, or internal credit unit.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code. Recommended only when value_type is monetary.

weight.description: Optional normalized contribution weight used in the allocation.

allocation_rule.description: The rule used to calculate or determine the value allocation.

settlement_period.description: Optional settlement period in YYYY-MM format.

calculation.description: Optional calculation details used to derive the allocation amount or weight.

total_value_pool.description: Optional total value pool from which this allocation was drawn.

trust_factor.description: Factor derived from trust profile or trust events.

decay_factor.description: Optional decay factor applied to older contributions.

formula.description: Optional human-readable formula or calculation explanation.

governance_policy.description: Optional reference to the governance policy used for this allocation.

policy_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the governance policy.

verification_status.description: Optional verification state of the allocation event.

risk_flags.description: Optional list of risk signals associated with this allocation.

dispute_status.description: Optional dispute status for the allocation event.

timestamp.description: The time when the value allocation event was issued, expressed in ISO 8601 date-time format.

context.description: Optional contextual information about the project, workflow, settlement, platform, or system in which this allocation was issued.
